title: A Non Commutative Grauert Theorem and Fourier Mukai Duality for Generalized Complex Tori
summary: We prove a generalization of Grauert's higher coherence theorem for a class of curved differential graded (non-commutative) Fréchet algebras. This allows us to extend the Fourier-Mukai calculus to derived categories arising in many new contexts. We then apply it and prove equivalence of derived categories of dual generalized complex tori using a non-commutative version of the Poincaré line bundle.
